name: al-cross-border
description: Albanian cross-border tax for tax year 2026 under Law No. 29/2023 'Për tatimin mbi të ardhurat' (as amended to Law No. 81/2025) and Law No. 9920/2008 on tax procedures. Covers tax residence of individuals (home, 183 days, centre of vital interests, the 24-month rule for foreign artists) and of companies (incorporation or management and control); what Albania taxes non-residents on (Albanian-source income, art. 4); permanent establishment; final withholding at 8% on dividends and 15% on interest,
author: openaccountants
